control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
positive communication before approaching mobile equipment
segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: unplanned release of kinetic energy at HT-9003

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control POSITIVE_COMMUNICATION_BEFORE_APPROACH: the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment on HT-9003 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling traffic on operating areas, specifically applying positive communication before approach. HT-9003 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was in place but did not perform. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 5 December 2022 a high potential incident was recorded on HT-9003 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during start-up after maintenance; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
